name: B10-0444/2026 (Verts/ALE) – The 2026 undemocratic elections to the Russian State Duma and its implications on civil society
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the undemocratic elections in the Russia State Duma and their implications for civil society
part_text:
The European Parliament says Russia's September 2026 parliamentary elections were not free or fair. It refuses to recognise the new State Duma as a legitimate parliament. It also rejects the voting held on occupied Ukrainian land. It asks the European Union to support Russian activists, independent journalists and human rights defenders, including with long-term money and easier paperwork for those living in the EU. It calls for sanctions on people who organised or ran in the votes on occupied territory. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament states positions and asks the EU and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** The new Russian Duma, Russian exiles and activists in the EU, and people involved in votes on occupied Ukrainian land.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the European Commission and Russian authorities. Any sanctions or funding depend on them.
